{"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D12","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 16 H7 (+0.018/0)"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 bore (D12) carries a tight ISO fit tolerance of 0.018 mm, but the drawing specifies a plating/coating (I.Z.B.P.) with no allowance for its thickness. The added coating will shrink the hole below the H7 limit and prevent the mating shaft from fitting. The designer should either increase the bore size to compensate for the plating thickness or add a note requiring the hole to be masked or re-machined after plating."
  , "recommended_correction": "Add plating thickness allowance to the bore dimension or specify masking/re-machining after plating."}]}
